message: 軍隊カレー

name: Lolotte
message: 「We aren't having much luck finding new shops, are we~」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, we've already checked out almost all of them.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to make things much, much livelier, so I want to increase the number of shops even more!」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, our only option is to check out the underground shops in the back alleys--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my? What could that place over there be?」
Stairs leading down to the semi-basement of a dilapidated building. Just before the entrance hangs a sign bearing a garish skull mark.

name: Synn
message: 「What was that place again... A curry shop, if I remember right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Curry and rice?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, though the vibe is so sketchy that nobody's ever gone in...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I cannot sit still after hearing the words 'curry and rice'! I'll be right back!」

name: Synn
message: 「Pretty sure it was some kind of eatery. Wait, Lolotte... where'd you go?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady has gone to have a meal.」

name: Synn
message: 「Riesling!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Authentic Spice Curry 'Land of Love.' It is managed by a comrade-in-arms of mine.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, is that right?」
Might as well have her introduce me while we're here.

name: Riesling
message: 「Jacqueline.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that the manager's name?」

name: Riesling
message: 「A woman once known as Death March Jacqueline.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Jacqueline was a chemical weapons specialist who sprinted across battlefields thick with artillery shells, holding defoliant in one hand and VX gas in the other.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Plants withered, beasts foamed at the mouth, and people collapsed. After she passed through, not even a single blade of grass remained... or so the legend goes.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's why she's Death March Jacqueline... Where on earth did you meet someone like that?」

name: Riesling
message: 「She was a classmate of mine back during our assassination training.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Assassination?」

name: Riesling
message: 「They are fond and nostalgic memories, indeed.」
Curry made by someone like that. True, both chemicals and spices come down to the blend--

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte's in danger!」
Just as I started to rush inside the shop, Lolotte emerged from within looking frail and weak.
She was swaying unsteadily on her feet, almost as if suddenly convulsing.

name: Synn
message: 「We have to administer an antidote fast. Riesling! What are you spacing out for?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gah... *cough*...」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you use in a situation like this, um, uh, if I remember right...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Pralidoxime methyl iodide. Also known as PAM.」

name: Riesling
message: 「However, more importantly right now--pardon my rudeness.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!」
Riesling suddenly reached into my coat pocket.

name: Riesling
message: 「This should prove to be a more effective remedy.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Milk?」
What a person... to have noticed that I always carry milk on me!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gulp, gulp... Phew. Ahh~~ I feel alive again~~」

name: Riesling
message: 「When one thinks of curry?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's hot. When you eat something hot and spicy, milk is good--wait, oh, I get it!」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is said to soothe spiciness better than water or tea.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's why you grabbed the milk... Wait, is Lolotte okay?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was so spicy~~\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Wait, so it wasn't poison or anything at all. Phew, that scared me.」
Come to think of it, if Lolotte were ever in real danger, Riesling would've acted immediately anyway.

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady. How was the taste of the Field Marshal Curry?」

name: Synn
message: 「Field Marshal?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Apparently it's a ranking system for spiciness. The higher the rank, the spicier it gets.」
Being a Marshal means it's way higher up than a Colonel or something, right.

name: Lolotte
message: 「But, Jiiya. Even for me, the Marshal Curry is impossible.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then around Sergeant Curry?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. It's Private Curry.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's...」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is super mild.」
Even as a curry lover, she really loves super sweet curry, huh.
